question: Who among the following won the gold medal in the girls' under 15 category at the Asian Juniors Individual Squash Championship in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anahat Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anahat Singh:**

 
 
• She is an **Indian squash player** who was born on March 13, 2008.
 
• She was the **youngest athlete to represent India at the 2022 Commonwealth Games**, having turned 14 years old.
 
• She took home the** Asian Junior Squash Individual Championships Girls U15 championship in June 2022.**
 
• She emerged **victorious at the August 2023 Asian Junior Squash Individual Championships in Dalian, China, winning the Girls U17 division.**
 
• Subsequently,** she won two bronze medals** in the women's team event and mixed doubles alongside Abhay Singh **in Asian Games, 2022.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Squash:**

 
 
• It is a** racquet and ball sports, **but squash's dynamics are very different from other racquet and ball sports like tennis etc.
 
• It was **created in England** in the **early 1800s** and has quickly become well-liked by players of all skill levels.
 
• It is a **part of the Asian Games since 1986 and the Commonwealth Games since 1998**, although** not yet being an Olympic sport.**
 
• Since the mid-1970s, there have also been high-profile, specialised competitions such as the World Squash Championships.
 
 
 
• Asians Games:
 
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from across Asia.
 
• They were regulated by the Asian Games Federation (AGF) till 1978.
 
• The first games were in New Delhi, India, in 1951.
 
• Since the breakup of the Asian Games Federation in 1982, the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) has organized the Games.
 
• The Games are recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and are described as the second largest multi-sport event after the Olympic Games.
 
• The next edition is expected to be held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan in 2026.
